name: Assumptions & Gaps
description: Working document capturing the things still in flux: open client questions, external dependencies, evidence gaps, and next discovery activities. Engine fills cover + the estimation assumptions; AI writes the four working narratives so the consultant has a concrete starting list to refine.

sections.title: Open client questions
sections.purpose: 3–5 markdown bullets capturing the most important unanswered questions surfaced by the analysis — questions for the client to answer before delivery commits. Each bullet: a clear question (not a statement), one phrase on why it matters. Do NOT invent owners or dates — those are human-fill. Skip housekeeping questions.

sections.title: External dependencies
sections.purpose: 3–5 markdown bullets of dependencies this engagement relies on: vendor APIs, upstream teams, ongoing migrations, regulatory windows. Each bullet: the dependency, the kind (vendor/system/team/decision), one phrase on the risk if it slips. Do NOT invent contacts.

sections.title: Gaps in evidence
sections.purpose: 3–6 markdown bullets calling out where evidence is thin — domains, systems, or process areas where the analysis lacked source documents, interviews, or code samples. Each bullet: the gap, why it matters for the assessment outcome. Mention the relevant domain (security, observability, etc.) in plain language, not as a code prefix.

sections.title: Recommended next discovery activities
sections.purpose: 4–6 markdown bullets proposing the discovery sessions, workshops, or document requests that should run next to close the gaps. Each bullet: the activity (workshop / document request / interview / system access), the intended output, and the rationale (which gap or open question it addresses). Do NOT paste the raw recommendations list — synthesise activities from gaps + open questions. No priority/domain prefixes.
